post.caption: A blue diamond cost $57.5 million. On May 18, 2016, Christie's sold the Oppenheimer Blue in Geneva. It is an emerald cut stone of 14.62 carats, named for a former owner, Sir Philip Oppenheimer. The GIA graded its color as Fancy Vivid Blue. The price was $57.5 million with fees, then the most ever paid for a jewel at auction, and Christie's called it the largest vivid blue diamond ever at auction. Its blue comes from tiny traces of boron in the crystal. The Pink Star broke that record in April 2017.
